# ci-local contract

Contract version: `1.0`

The `ci-local` category defines 2 capabilities: 1 required and 1 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |

| `ci-local.run-workflow` | required | no | `workflow` | `status`, `logs` | - | - | Run a repository's CI workflow(s) locally. |

## Details

### ci-local.run-workflow

- Status: required

### ci-local.list-jobs
